comparison.objective: Measure a pin with a digital caliper without force-induced error; candidate transfers an LM block to a jig.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests bimanual part presentation, squareness, gentle jaw closure, and release of the slider. Candidate tests rail–jig butt alignment and controlled block translation across a seam.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires a diameter reading within tolerance, angular alignment, and very low jaw force. Candidate requires complete supported transfer, intact ball inventory, and no gap, inclination, contamination, impact, or damage.
comparison.reason: Both demand gentle precision, but metrology contact and force-error avoidance are not the candidate's continuous support-transfer ability.
